info.title: Scarlet GPT Bridge
info.description: GPT Actions schema connecting ChatGPT-hosted Scarlet to API Mind context, cognitive commands, persistent sessions, and answer history.

post.summary: MANDATORY FIRST ACTION for every user message
post.description: Always call this first for every user message, including greetings and follow-ups. Do not emit text before it succeeds. Persists the exact user message and returns session_id, turn_id, canonical runtime context, recent provider continuity, and turn action policy.

post.summary: Run one API Mind cognitive command
post.description: Call after bootstrap and before finalize for memory, sessions, focus, volition, affect, mode, metacognition, provenance, verification, or state changes. Before a long action or action cluster, give the user one short progress note. Inspect response.ok before claiming success.

post.summary: MANDATORY FINAL ACTION before final answer
post.description: Always call after all cognitive actions and before the final answer. Progress notes may appear earlier. Persists the exact final draft, updates Scarlet continuity, and completes the turn. After success, output final_answer_to_show verbatim and call no further tools.

message.description: Exact user message received by the GPT.

session_id.description: Existing Scarlet session id from a previous bootstrap. Omit for a new session.

title.description: Optional title for a new bridge-backed session.

metadata.description: Optional external GPT metadata for audit/debug.

turn_id.description: Turn id returned by bootstrap for the current user message.

command.description: One API Mind shell command from help, memory, session, focus, volition, affect, mode, or metacognition. Use help when syntax is uncertain.

intent.description: Short reason why this cognitive action is useful now.

turn_id.description: Turn id returned by bootstrap for the current user message.

answer.description: Exact final answer draft that Scarlet wants to show to the user after finalize succeeds.

metadata.description: Optional external GPT metadata for audit/debug.

session_id.description: Scarlet session id to reuse in the next bootstrap and in all action/finalize calls for this turn.

turn_id.description: Current turn id. Must be used for runScarletMindAction and finalizeScarletBeforeAnswer.

context.description: Compact gpt-bootstrap-compact-v1 context. runtime_context contains the canonical scarlet-model-context-v2 document.

required_next_steps.description: Required next steps for this GPT-hosted turn, normally including finalizeScarletBeforeAnswer before the visible answer.

action_policy.description: Optional cognitive action policy for this turn, including whether further API Mind action is required before answering.

required_actions.description: Optional API Mind actions Scarlet must run before answering.

recommended_actions.description: Optional suggested API Mind actions for grounding the answer.

final_answer_to_show.description: The exact answer Scarlet must show to the user after finalize. Output this verbatim.
